label: upubhub class (textbook, lesson plans, assessments)
summary: A short course a teacher uploads to upubhub.com and teaches from: an original textbook with discussion topics, one lesson plan per lesson, class assessment settings and an upload checklist. Uploading and class setup stay with the teacher.
planner_text:
Plan a course package in the project folder, not software. Settings: class code subject {{subject_code}}, level {{level}} (written as two digits), {{lessons}} lessons, sources: {{sources}}, illustrations: {{illustrations}}, assessments: {{attempts}} attempts, {{strictness}} grading, weighted toward {{emphasis}}. Follow upubhub-class-format.md exactly; the dashboard's course-package check enforces it.
Stories, in order: (1) human sign-off on the course brief: subject, scope, audience, reading level, lesson count and measurable objectives per lesson. (2) human sign-off on the source plan: original writing, or named open-licence sources (CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0 or public domain) with author and https link. Never invent a licence or a credit; only the teacher can attest to reuse rights. (3) agent outline: write course/course.json with the class code in `code` (SUBJ:LL-Class name, exactly as the project settings give it), lessons, section headings and objectives. (4) agent textbook stories, one per lesson and parallel, each writing course/textbook/<lesson>.md with one "## " heading per section exactly as in course.json. (5) agent discussion topics: course/topics.json, at most 12 per lesson, anchors copied from the lesson text. (6) illustrations only when the illustrations setting is yes, using the media stages (inventory, generate in Media studio after spend approval, publish, integrate); images live in assets/img and are referenced from the lesson Markdown with alt text. (7) a read-only fact-check story on a different model from the writer; its findings become fix stories. (8) agent lesson plans, one per lesson, parallel. (9) agent assessment settings, one per lesson. (10) agent static verification titled "Verify course package files" with verification_stage "static": re-read every file against the format guide and fix mismatches; the dashboard runs the course-package check when the operator accepts this story and lists every problem. (11) agent UPLOAD.md: the step-by-step upload and class-setup checklist. (12) human, in upubhub: review the drafts, publish lessons, create the class, share the textbook, assign lessons and set up assessment. No containers, deployment, CI, pull requests or application code. No model chooses classroom ids or uploads anything.
failure_points: A lesson heading that differs from course.json by one character breaks the package; copy the headings, do not retype them.
A topic anchor must occur exactly once in its section, on a plain prose line; upubhub rejects anchors inside links, images, code or markup.
upubhub assesses at most 12 topics and 60,000 characters per assigned lesson set; split long lessons instead of trimming quality.
Generated text is declared ai_generated or ai_assisted, never human-written.
A borrowed passage or image without a credit, an allowed licence and an https source cannot be uploaded; prefer original writing.
The writer checking its own facts misses its own errors; the fact-check story uses a different model and reads the lesson text, not the outline.
visual_checks: The teacher reads every lesson and lesson plan before upload; illustrations are approved in Media studio before they are integrated.
human_signoffs: Approve the course brief and objectives
Approve the source and licence plan
Approve media spending and select/publish illustrations in the project Media tab, when illustrations are requested
Upload, publish and set up the class in upubhub

checks.message: Start with a human sign-off on the course brief and measurable objectives.
Add a human sign-off on the source and licence plan; only the teacher can attest to reuse rights.
Add the static verification story "Verify course package files"; the dashboard runs the course-package check when it is accepted.
Add a read-only fact-check story on a different model from the writer.
Lessons, topics and plans are planned before the outline that fixes their headings.
Uploading, publishing and class setup in upubhub are the teacher's steps.
A course package needs no containers, deployment, CI or pull requests.

customize.label: Subject code
customize.prompt: The class code's subject: 3 to 5 capital letters from the list. GEN is the catch-all for everyday general-knowledge topics; NEWS, TECH and ENGR cover how today's things work. Meanings are in class-codes.md.

customize.label: Level
customize.prompt: Reading level as a grade equivalent: 0 kindergarten, 1 to 12 grades, 13 to 16 college years. For a general adult audience, 9 or 10 reads easily. Shown as two digits in the class code.

customize.label: Class name
customize.prompt: The class's name as students will see it, for example Forces and Motion.

customize.label: Subject and scope
customize.prompt: What the course teaches, and what is in and out of scope. Mention vocabulary to avoid or require.

customize.label: Source details
customize.prompt: For open-licence sources: title, author, licence (CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, CC0 or public domain) and an https link for each.

customize.label: Illustration style
customize.prompt: Style and roughly how many images, if lessons are illustrated.
